name: Berserker
description: Old Norse warriors said to fight in a trance-like fury (berserkergang), sometimes ascribed bear-like or wolf-like ferocity. Documented in skaldic poetry and the sagas, and outlawed in early-medieval Scandinavia.
origin: Documented across the Viking-Age Norse world: Norway, Iceland, Sweden, Denmark, and the wider areas of Norse settlement and raiding (British Isles, Faroes, North Atlantic).
